items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I had this thought earlier today when we were with Warren Bernhardt

ctx.x: Well I can do all the things involved with making a film. If I have enough money I don’t want to do any of them, I just hire people. But the way things have gone, these days you have to do everything almost.

I had this thought earlier today when we were with Warren Bernhardt, and then thinking about what you do and what he does, and a little bit of what I do, and that we sort of live on the fringe. But I think it’s important.
I don’t think Warren lives on the fringe. Warren is right in the center of existence.
